name: Dried figs
description: Figs dried to chewy sweetness — soaked overnight and eaten through winter.

tcm.note: Drying concentrates and warms; the fresh fruit is neutral.

ayurveda.note: Drying turns the fresh fruit's shita — anjeer is a winter, building food.

unani.note: Anjeer is har-ratab in Unani, soaked overnight and taken as a winter tonic and laxative.

histamine.note: Dried fruit — concentrated, and commonly sulphured, which is why the dried sits well above the fresh.

guna.note: Fresh and simple — the sattvic default for plant food eaten close to how it grew.
